Locked before you start. Released when it's approved.
Your client locks USDC for each milestone. When a milestone is approved, it's released to you: to your wallet where that's allowed, or as VND to your bank account in Vietnam.

Today, the work comes first. The money comes later.
Freelancers deliver the work, then wait for the money.
Clients are asked to send money up front, before they see any work.
Sign in with Google. Say where you live.
No seed phrase. Your wallet is set up when you sign in.
Live in Vietnam? The app shows only VND.
You can change it in Settings.
Your client writes one brief.
Milestones, deadlines, and what counts as done for each one.
Its fingerprint is saved on the chain, so neither side can change it.
The brief travels encrypted inside the invite link. The link can't move money.
You read the brief, then choose once where the money goes.
You choose once, when you accept the contract. You never type an address.
In Vietnam: VND to your bank through a payout partner (simulated in the demo).
Partner in talks · simulated in the demo
Your client locks it before you start.
The whole amount, per milestone, held by the program.
No instruction lets N.E.D move the locked money.
You can see it's there
Submit before the deadline.
The time and a fingerprint of your work are recorded.
Your files stay on your computer. Only their fingerprints are saved.
Your client checks the work, then releases it.
Each link is checked against the fingerprint saved when you submitted.
Your client approves, and that part is released.
No answer by the review deadline? Anyone can press Release now, unless the client requested changes in time.
Miss a submission deadline, and that milestone's money goes back to the client.
After the deadline, anyone can release.
No neutral arbiter yet.
Where you live decides how you receive it.
Bank transfers need an identity check by the partner.
Every step leaves a record.
Every lock and release is a public record.
When every milestone is done, the contract can be closed.
Not tax advice.
Your phone and your computer, one wallet.
The wallet panel in the Workspace is the N.E.D app itself. Same Google sign-in.
Open a contract on any device you sign in on.
You confirm every step that moves money.
N.E.D is software. The money moves by the contract's rules.

What N.E.D doesN.E.D Milestone Lock is software that lets a freelancer and a client agree on work in milestones, with the money locked before work starts.Every step leaves a public record (Solana Explorer) and a Records page.
What N.E.D doesn't doIt does not hold money, convert money, or charge a fee during the pilot.No instruction lets N.E.D move the locked money.
